hb-last: Last {{when}} · pages after {{limit}} min of silence
hb-never: No check-in yet — not watched until the first one.
heartbeats-body: Senders on the VPS check in with the watchdog; silence past the limit pages.
link-description: What is paging right now, who acknowledged it, and whether every sender is checking in.
not-configured-body: Set ONCALL_URL and ONCALL_SIGNING_SECRET in .env.production and restart web. Paging itself does not depend on this page.
rule-save-failed: Could not save the alarm rule. Try again.
rules-body: Thresholds over the one-minute metrics history. Defaults live in lib/ops/alarm-rules.ts; a change here overrides the code until you reset it.
rules-failed: Could not load the alarm rules. Refresh to try again.
unreachable-body: The watchdog did not answer. Paging runs on the watchdog itself, so alerts still reach #rmh-oncall — check there.
